
		<h1 class="postTitle">
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/showonce/p/19403767" title="发布于 2025-12-26 11:21">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">群晖通过 acme.sh 申请 ZeroSSL 泛域名证书（适配 80 端口封锁）+ 自动续期同步完整步骤</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">说明</h2>
<ul class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<li>适配场景：运营商封锁 80 端口，无法通过 HTTP-01 验证申请证书</li>
<li>证书类型：泛域名 SSL 证书（<a class="link-bJL8ai" href="https://xjunqiang.cn/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">xjunqiang.cn</a>&nbsp;+ *.<a class="link-bJL8ai" href="https://xjunqiang.cn/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">xjunqiang.cn</a>），有效期 90 天</li>
<li>核心保障：自动续期 + 自动同步到指定证书目录，永久有效</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">一、前置准备</h3>
<p>群晖开启 SSH 并登录，切换 root 用户：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>sudo -i</pre>
</div>
<ol class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<li>获取阿里云 AccessKey（域名解析需托管在阿里云）：
<ul class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<li>登录阿里云控制台 → 头像 → AccessKey 管理 → 创建 AccessKey</li>
<li>保存<code>AccessKey ID</code>和<code>AccessKey Secret</code>（后续配置用）</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">二、安装 acme.sh（适配群晖精简系统）</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 强制安装acme.sh（忽略crontab/socat提示）</span>
curl https://get.acme.sh | sh -s email=你的邮箱@163.com --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">force

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 加载acme.sh（群晖ash shell无需bashrc）</span>
alias acme.sh='/root/.acme.sh/acme.sh'</pre>
</div>
<h3 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">三、配置阿里云 API 并申请证书（DNS-01 验证）</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 替换为你的阿里云AccessKey</span>
export Ali_Key=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你的AccessKey ID</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
export Ali_Secret</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你的AccessKey Secret</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 申请泛域名证书（自动添加/删除DNS TXT记录）</span>
/root/.acme.sh/acme.sh --issue --dns dns_ali -d xjunqiang.cn -d *.xjunqiang.cn --force</pre>
</div>
<ul class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<li>等待脚本执行完成，看到<code>Cert success</code>即为申请成功</li>
<li>证书生成路径：<code><code>/root/.acme.sh/xjunqiang.cn_ecc/</code></code></li>
</ul>
<h3 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">四、将证书部署到未使用的 QU91tw 目录（安全替换）</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 备份QU91tw原证书</span>
mkdir -p /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">bak
cp </span>/usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/*.pem /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/bak/

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 清空QU91tw旧证书</span>
rm <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">-f</span> /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{cert,chain,fullchain,privkey}.pem

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 复制新证书（适配acme.sh的.cer格式→群晖.pem格式）</span>
cp /root/.acme.sh/xjunqiang.cn_ecc/xjunqiang.cn.cer /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cert.pem
cp </span>/root/.acme.sh/xjunqiang.cn_ecc/ca.cer /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">chain.pem
cp </span>/root/.acme.sh/xjunqiang.cn_ecc/fullchain.cer /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">fullchain.pem
cp </span>/root/.acme.sh/xjunqiang.cn_ecc/xjunqiang.cn.key /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">privkey.pem

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 修复证书权限（群晖硬性要求）</span>
chmod 400 /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.pem
chown root:root </span>/usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.pem

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 验证证书有效期（应显示2026-03-26）</span>
openssl x509 -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/cert.pem -noout -dates</pre>
</div>
<h3 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">五、创建证书同步脚本（续期后自动覆盖 QU91tw）</h3>
<p>　　这里的QU911w是我自己在DSM的证书正添加的，这个可以在SSH中去查看</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建同步脚本</span>
cat &gt; /root/.acme.sh/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sync_qu91tw.sh &lt;&lt; EOF
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">!/bin/bash</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 同步续期后的证书到QU91tw</span>
cp /root/.acme.sh/xjunqiang.cn_ecc/xjunqiang.cn.cer /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cert.pem
cp </span>/root/.acme.sh/xjunqiang.cn_ecc/ca.cer /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">chain.pem
cp </span>/root/.acme.sh/xjunqiang.cn_ecc/fullchain.cer /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">fullchain.pem
cp </span>/root/.acme.sh/xjunqiang.cn_ecc/xjunqiang.cn.key /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">privkey.pem

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 修复权限</span>
chmod 400 /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.pem
chown root:root </span>/usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.pem

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 重启nginx生效</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">systemctl restart nginx
EOF

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 给脚本添加执行权限</span>
chmod +x /root/.acme.sh/sync_qu91tw.sh</pre>
</div>
<h3 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">六、绑定续期钩子（acme.sh 续期后自动执行同步）</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 写入续期钩子到证书配置文件</span>
sed -i '<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$a</span> RENEW_HOOK=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/root/.acme.sh/sync_qu91tw.sh</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>' /root/.acme.sh/xjunqiang.cn_ecc/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">xjunqiang.cn.conf

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 验证钩子是否添加成功（显示RENEW_HOOK=脚本路径即成功）</span>
grep <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">RENEW_HOOK</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /root/.acme.sh/xjunqiang.cn_ecc/xjunqiang.cn.conf</pre>
</div>
<h3 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">七、配置 DSM 任务计划（兜底同步，双重保险）</h3>
<ol class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<li>登录 DSM → 控制面板 → 任务计划 → 新增 → 「计划的任务」→ 「用户定义的脚本」</li>
<li>常规设置：
<ul class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<li>任务名称：证书同步到 QU91tw</li>
<li>用户：root（必须选 root）</li>
<li>勾选「启动时运行」（可选）</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>计划设置：
<ul class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<li>频率：每月</li>
<li>日期：23 号（acme.sh 续期后 1 天）</li>
<li>时间：凌晨 3 点</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>任务设置 → 执行命令：/root/.acme.sh/sync_qu91tw.sh</li>
<li>保存并测试运行（无报错即成功）</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">八、验证所有配置（可选）</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 查看acme.sh证书列表（确认Renew时间）</span>
/root/.acme.sh/acme.sh --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">list

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 手动测试同步脚本（无报错即成功）</span>
/root/.acme.sh/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sync_qu91tw.sh

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 查看QU91tw证书最终有效期</span>
openssl x509 -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/cert.pem -noout -dates</pre>
</div>
<h3 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">九、备用命令（手动续期 / 同步）</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 手动续期证书</span>
/root/.acme.sh/acme.sh --renew -d xjunqiang.cn --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">force

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 手动同步到QU91tw</span>
/root/.acme.sh/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sync_qu91tw.sh

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 回滚QU91tw原证书（如需恢复）</span>
cp /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/bak/*.pem /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/ &amp;&amp; systemctl restart nginx</pre>
</div>
<p>------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------</p>
<h3 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">核心保障逻辑</h3>
<ol class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<li>自动续期：acme.sh 默认提前 30 天（2026-02-23）自动续期证书</li>
<li>自动同步：续期后通过 RENEW_HOOK 自动执行脚本，同步新证书到 QU91tw</li>
<li>兜底同步：DSM 任务计划每月 23 号强制同步，避免钩子失效</li>
<li>权限保障：同步脚本自动修复证书权限，符合群晖要求</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">关键注意事项</h3>
<ol class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<li>阿里云 AccessKey 需保留 DNS 解析 API 权限，不可删除 / 禁用</li>
<li>证书有效期 90 天，续期后自动刷新，无需手动干预</li>
<li>同步脚本仅影响 QU91tw 目录，不干扰当前使用的 VfnWJK 证书</li>
</ol>
<p>DSM 任务计划需确保用户为 root，否则无权限操作证书目录<br><br><br></p>
<p><em>------------------------------------------------------------------</em><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong>完</strong></span><em>----------------------------------------------------------------------</em></p>
<p><strong>补充：</strong></p>
<p><strong>任务计划名称不要用中文，用英文的。</strong></p>
<p><strong>如何查看当前的默认证书（SSH）：cat /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/DEFAULT</strong><br><strong>如何查看自己在DSM中创建的证书信息（SSH）：openssl x509 -in /usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/QU91tw/cert.pem -noout -dates</strong></p>
</div>
